notes: The account page's profile card (#946): the avatar, the name and the email that stand in for the member on the page the card is drawn on. `origin` is the card, because the page's frame and the app's frame are different heights and the design is the gaps inside the card, not where it lands on the 852px screen. `capture` is the card, because it is the region both clients draw identically. Widths of the name and email are left out deliberately - they are the run of the words, not a decision. Colours are left out too - they are what the raster proves. The card needs a session, so a recording has to sign in as the fixture account. The surface is declared here and not yet under `docs/mobile/visual-gate.json`, because the allowance card (#947) is still the page's and the surface stays off until the page is whole (#948, ADR-0117).
